mapper.select:
SELECT , c.category_name, m.bbs_name, m.bbs_code, a.created_at AS created_at_view, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_file f WHERE f.file_group_id = a.file_group_id AND f.delete_yn = 'N') AS file_count, (SELECT f2.file_id FROM tb_file f2 WHERE f2.file_group_id = a.file_group_id AND f2.delete_yn = 'N' AND f2.is_image_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY f2.sort_order, f2.file_id LIMIT 1) AS thumb_file_id FROM tb_bbs_article a JOIN tb_bbs_master m ON m.bbs_master_id = a.bbs_master_id LEFT JOIN tb_bbs_category c ON c.category_id = a.category_id
ORDER BY a.notice_yn DESC, a.created_at DESC, a.article_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT , c.category_name, m.bbs_code, m.bbs_name, m.site_code, a.created_at AS created_at_view FROM tb_bbs_article a JOIN tb_bbs_master m ON m.bbs_master_id = a.bbs_master_id LEFT JOIN tb_bbs_category c ON c.category_id = a.category_id WHERE a.article_id = #{articleId} AND a.delete_yn = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_bbs_article ( article_id, bbs_master_id, category_id, file_group_id, writer_user_id, writer_user_type, writer_name, writer_password, title, content, press_name, link_url, published_at, notice_yn, secret_yn, client_ip, status, created_by, created_ip, created_at, updated_by, updated_ip, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{articleId}, #{bbsMasterId}, #{categoryId}, #{fileGroupId}, #{writerUserId}, #{writerUserType}, #{writerName}, #{writerPassword}, #{title}, #{content}, #{pressName}, #{linkUrl}, #{publishedAt}, #{noticeYn}, #{secretYn}, #{clientIp}, #{status}, #{createdBy}, #{createdIp}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedIp}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_bbs_article SET category_id = #{categoryId}, file_group_id = #{fileGroupId}, title = #{title}, content = #{content}, press_name = #{pressName}, link_url = #{linkUrl}, published_at = #{publishedAt}, notice_yn = #{noticeYn}, secret_yn = #{secretYn}, status = #{status}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_ip = #{updatedIp}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE article_id = #{articleId}
UPDATE tb_bbs_article SET delete_yn = 'Y', status = 'DELETED', updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_ip = #{updatedIp}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE article_id = #{articleId}
UPDATE tb_bbs_article SET view_count = view_count + 1, updated_at = updated_at WHERE article_id = #{articleId} AND delete_yn = 'N'

UPDATE tb_bbs_article a SET a.comment_count = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_bbs_comment c WHERE c.article_id = a.article_id AND c.delete_yn = 'N' AND c.status = 'PUBLISHED'), a.updated_at = a.updated_at WHERE a.article_id = #{articleId}
